text.en: Kills with this weapon leave behind Remnants. Absorbing a Remnant converts your next hipfired shot into an ally-seeking Noble Round and partially refills the magazine.

Kills create a Remnant which tracks towards you when within a 10 meter radius. Remnants last for 8 seconds in the world before despawning.

Remnants <title refill [G_refill] /> 4 rounds into the magazine and grant one stack of 'Noble Rounds'. Maximum of 6 stacks.
